dedupe_keys.name: sistema nacional de cartografia de zonas inundables

description: Sistema Nacional de Cartografía de Zonas Inundables is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Cartographic viewer integrated into the Spatial Data Infrastructure of the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge where you can consult the available cartography of the floodable areas of Spain, as well as the land of Public Hydraulic Domain and associated areas. Coverage: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The portal shows the English title as "National Flood Zone Mapping System" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Its keywords include dominio público hidráulico, zona de flujo preferente, peligrosidad, riesgo, inundación, zona de policía. The listing shows 2022-06-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.miteco.gob.es/es/atencion-al-ciudadano/aviso-legal.aspx). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
